source: make an incremental game where you collect leafs that are on the floor and you can buy upgrades for leafs and make the map a flat field and make the game 3d

image_prompt.text: A central upgrades storefront on the field that the player keeps returning to in order to spend collected leaves
Walkable circulation across the flat field chaining the upgrade storefront to the leaf-covered ground
Purchase walls closing off higher-tier stretches of the field that drop away once bought
A flat open field with no terrain relief, leaves lying loose across the grass

layout_placement.text: Leaves scattered on the floor as the gatherable the whole loop is built on

notes: Incremental but not Idle: the player walks the field to gather, so this keeps a layout job rather than routing P5.
Neither the flatness of the field nor the explicit 3D requirement matches an option; both are carried as free text.
